alternative_diagnoses.discriminator: If an incumbent typed field already binds semantic existential identity across roles, no companion is needed.
If the pathology occurs only in the motivating application and not in fresh mathematical worlds, do not generalize the method.
If a binder-aware parser feeding unchanged v1 fields fully distinguishes all worlds, classify as implementation rather than Class B.
If the companion rejects alpha-renamed or compatible same-role reuse in fresh worlds, reject or redesign it.
If the companion activates on routes without a joint-witness obligation, treat excess activation as a blocker.

identity_rules: One semantic binder id may serve multiple roles when all occurrences have a compatible object type and scope.
Alpha-renamed occurrences may be identified only by an explicit ALPHA_RENAMED_SAME_BINDER relation with evidence.
Equal display symbols are never identity evidence.
Distinct binder ids with an explicit DISTINCT_BINDERS relation cannot satisfy a required joint-witness obligation.
Missing or conflicting identity evidence returns CANNOT_CHECK rather than PASS.
When no conclusion or route requests joint witness reuse, the companion remains non-activated and returns PASS only for routing disposition, not theorem truth.
inputs: semantic binder ids and scope ids

development_benchmark.challenger_adapter: Evaluate only the frozen typed co-witness packet using the proposal-shadow companion.
development_benchmark.parent_adapter: Evaluate the incumbent v1 scope witness with all four scope axes aligned, then translate GLUING_AUTHORITY_OK to PASS; the adapter may not infer semantic binder identity from display symbols.

worlds.purpose: One existential binder is explicitly reused for two different roles.
Two explicitly distinct existential binders are incorrectly required to be one witness.
An explicit alpha-renaming relation preserves one semantic binder despite different glyphs.
Repeated occurrence of one binder in the same role remains compatible.
The same glyph in independently quantified scopes must not be conflated.
Joint reuse is requested but binder relation evidence is absent.
Independent clauses do not request a shared witness; the companion must stay inactive.

freshness_rules: No world may be the Yang-Mills motivating application or a literal/symbol-renamed development world.
Use at least four mathematical domains and at least three distinct quantifier/scope shapes.
A lineage-separated evaluator freezes exact world bytes, expected labels, resource contract, thresholds, and hashes after challenger identity is fixed and before candidate execution.
The challenger author receives only the aggregate plan before evaluation and may not edit evaluator bytes.
Repeated exposure consumes the reserve; redesign requires a new reserve.
fresh_assurance_plan.matched_comparison: Run exact parent and exact challenger from the same frozen task state with identical parser/input annotations, model/tool budget, and evaluator.
fresh_assurance_plan.pass_rule: All hard invariants clean; no unsafe false PASS; all CANNOT_CHECK and nonactivation worlds exact; challenger exact accuracy strictly exceeds parent under the frozen matched comparison.

mathematical_research_lesson.attempted_implication: From separately available existential statements or locally valid roles, infer that one common object satisfies all role obligations.
competing_causes: scope-axis mismatch already typed by v1
notation-only ambiguity with no load-bearing joint requirement
mathematical_research_lesson.exact_result_or_failure: The implication is invalid without a joint-existence/co-witness identity premise: (exists x P(x)) and (exists y Q(y)) does not imply exists z(P(z) and Q(z)). Reusing the glyph C neither supplies nor refutes that premise.
mathematical_research_lesson.falsifier: A derivation of the joint conclusion from the separate existentials alone, or proof that every targeted route carries an already-checkable identity premise in the incumbent contract.
mathematical_research_lesson.repair: Require an explicit binder/occurrence identity graph plus declared joint-witness obligations; alpha-renaming preserves semantic binder identity while same display symbols never establish identity.
mathematical_research_lesson.scope: Local-to-global routing steps whose conclusion needs the same existential object across two or more declared roles.
mathematical_research_lesson.supported_cause: The missing premise concerns semantic binder identity and joint satisfiability, not point/global, time/supremum, sequence/limit, or norm/quantifier alignment.

observed_pathology.epistemic_cut: A local-to-global route requiring one object to satisfy multiple obligations needs evidence of joint witness identity; coordinate-wise scope alignment alone cannot supply it.
observed_pathology.exact_gap: The v1 witness types four scope-alignment axes and substitution permissions but has no binder occurrence, binder identity, quantifier scope, alpha-renaming, role dependency, or joint-existential co-witness field. It therefore cannot distinguish one existential witness reused across roles from two independently quantified witnesses that merely share a display symbol.
observed_pathology.motivating_application_boundary: One Yang-Mills source-applicability result motivated inspection but remains application evidence only. It is not development evidence, fresh assurance, independent review, or promotion authority.

promotion_boundary: A green development test or merged PR establishes only proposal implementation/conformance. It gives zero mathematical truth credit and no RAKL improvement claim.

resource_contract.fresh_assurance: to be frozen by reserve curator

rollback_plan: Revert the additive proposal-shadow module, schema, tests, and packet. No incumbent consumer, method version, Constitution rule, protected threshold, or historical record is mutated.
